newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SOOTS TURISM SHARE ISSUE TO CONTINUE ON MONDAY.
newsitem.headline: SOOTS TURISM SHARE ISSUE TO CONTINUE ON MONDAY.

text.p: Hoiupank Investments will continue Soots Turism share emission on April 8, which was stopped earlier this week, the company said on Friday.
"Securities inspectorate gave the permission (to continue the emission) and lengthened the subscription deadline to April 15," Raul Hindov, a project leader for Hoiupank Investments, told Reuters.
"Subscriptions made since March 25 or before the issue was stopped are still in force," he added.

The securities inspectorate on Monday stopped the public offer of catering company Soots because the company had not registered its shares in the central depository although it said it had in its prospectus.
Soots announced a public offer of 5.4 million kroons, which will raise the company's share capital to 14 million kroons.
